snippet.title: Stellar Bewitching (Remastered) - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi everyone! Here's a trailer for the remastered version of Stellar Bewitching! Featuring a gorgeous art overhaul by Berry B, and some gameplay/QoL updates to bring a fun turn-based RPG experience for both veterans and newbies alike. Enjoy a Sci-fi turn-based RPG experience revolving around teenage drama, the limbo realm, and other unforeseen forces.

Special thanks to Berry B for his amazing financial contribution to my games and his support, which made many of my game's assets possible.😍

Stellar Bewitching (Remastered) on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2561090/Stellar_Bewitching_Remastered/

Stellar Bewitching (Remastered) on Itch:
https://starmage.itch.io/stellar-bewitching

Hope you all enjoy it! ^_^

Music:
ISAoSOUND AIRYLUVS
